name: DonorStewardshipPlanner
tagline: Thank every donor within 48 hours, keep every relationship on plan and never miss an impact report.
description: A complete donor stewardship app for nonprofits in one PCF control: a thank-you queue with a 48-hour SLA clock (weekdays only if you like) and a personal-thanks rule for larger gifts, stewardship touchpoints as a list, board and month calendar, stewardship plans generated from a template by recognition level, recognition level changes from giving, an impact report schedule and steward workload. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, with built-in demo data.
features: Thank-you SLA in hours with weekend exclusion and a live countdown
Personal thanks (phone, video, in person) required above a threshold
Late reason required when the SLA was missed
Thanking a gift completes its planned thank-you touchpoint or logs one
Outcome notes required for calls, visits and meetings; follow-up planned in the same step
Stewardship plan template (Type+days@level) generates the missing touchpoints per donor
Recognition levels from rolling 12 months, fiscal year or lifetime giving; apply level-ups with a recognition touchpoint
Pause / close donors with automatic skipping of planned contacts (thank-yous stay)
Reschedule, +7 days, reassign and bulk actions
Undo, CSV export, keyboard shortcuts, notes history
Power Fx outputs and OnSelect / OnChange / OnCreate / OnSave / OnAction / OnStatusChange events
